When the people of South Carolina sent us to Washington, we made a promise: to work for YOU.

We have NEVER voted to raise your taxes in Congress because when you work hard for your money, it should stay in your pockets.

South Carolina STRONG.

Law and order starts with a justice system willing to follow the law.

Right now, unelected activist judges are bypassing the Senate confirmation process and undermining the president's constitutional authority to appoint U.S. Attorneys. After the 120-day interim term expires, federal judges are installing their own picks indefinitely. No Senate confirmation. No accountability. No end date.

A judicial power grab being used to override the will of the American people and block President Trump fr

PFAS chemicals are in our water, our soil, and our communities. Our seniors deserve to know if these forever chemicals are in their blood.

We cosponsored the Expanding Seniors' Access to PFAS Testing Act to require Medicare to cover PFAS blood testing for seniors.

Early detection saves lives. And a Medicare program working for our seniors, not against them, is exactly what they deserve.

We are standing up for every senior in the Lowcountry and across South Carolina. Your health is worth prote

We’ve tried multiple times to remove Ilhan Omar from Congress, but have been consistently blocked from doing so.

Our Constitutional Amendment to ensure anyone serving in the federal government was born in America is something we need ahead of the midterms this year.

We work for America, and America ONLY.

Our daughters are worth protecting. Logan Federico's life was worth protecting. Logan Federico deserved to come home.

The South Carolina system of injustice failed her. Every judge who released her killer. Every politician who pushed soft-on-crime policies. 

This is what happens when the people running our justice system care more about the feelings of criminals than the safety of the innocent. This is what happens when judges treat repeat offenders like victims and treat actual victims like a

No child should have their body permanently altered, and no doctor should ever get away with it.

We introduced the Childhood Genital Mutilation Prevention Act to make it a federal crime. Any doctor or activist who performs or pushes these procedures on kids faces steep fines and up to 10 years in prison. Additionally, providers who perform them would be permanently banned from Medicare. Not a single taxpayer dollar should EVER fund child mutilation.

The Left doesn't get to gamble with children

We are one nation under God. Not one nation under Muhammad. 

Sharia law has no place in America.

A lot of you know, when I dropped out of school at just 17 years old, I got my first job working at the Waffle House at College Park Road in Ladson. My parents told me if I wasn't going to go to school, I had to go to work.

From there I went on to become the first female to graduate from the Corps of Cadets at The Citadel, where I was taught discipline, accountability, leadership, and how to keep going even when things got tough.

From those experiences, I knew I wanted to make a difference. I

For too long, America’s veterans came home sick and spent years begging the government to recognize their illnesses were connected to their military service.

From Agent Orange in Vietnam to toxic burn pits in Iraq and Afghanistan, generations of veterans were exposed to dangerous chemicals which left many with cancer, lung disease, and other serious illnesses.

We voted YES on the Honoring Our PACT Act to expand VA health care and benefits for veterans exposed to burn pits, Agent Orange, and ot

When survivors of domestic violence finally flee, the IRS shouldn't be waiting on the other side of the door.

This is why we introduced the Tax Fairness for Abuse Survivors Act, legislation focused on protecting domestic violence survivors and ensuring no victim is ever left carrying tax burdens created under fear, manipulation, or threats.

No one should carry the financial scars left by the predator who abused them. Our legislation strengthens and expands vital protections so survivors can fi

The fraud in Minnesota is just the tip of the iceberg.

Vice President Vance has made it his mission to weed out and expose the billions of dollars in taxpayer dollars being stolen. $22 billion in fraudulent small business loans. $1.3 billion in fraudulent Medicaid reimbursements. $135 billion stolen after the floodgates were opened in the immediate aftermath of COVID. $6.3 billion in suspected fraudulent government contracts awarded during the last administration. 

We trust the Trump Administr

We cosponsored the Improving Seniors' Timely Access to Care Act to require Medicare Advantage plans to establish electronic prior authorization programs capable of providing real-time decisions on items and services routinely approved. No more unnecessary delays on care seniors have already earned.

Every single year these plans must publicly publish their prior authorization data, including the percentage of requests approved and the average response time. Full transparency. No more hiding behi

Making America Safe Again has been a top priority from day one, and we are working alongside President Trump to deliver. 

For years, the radical left demonized police officers, defunded departments, installed soft-on-crime prosecutors, and opened our borders to violent criminals who flooded into American communities. 

Law-abiding citizens were left to pay the price. Those days are over.

You don't flee the third world to turn America into the country you left behind.

INTRODUCING: The No Immigration Without Assimilation Act.

This bill is simple: if you hate America, you don't get to come here or stay here. Period.

Before anyone receives any immigration benefit, the Department of Homeland Security will conduct a full screening to determine:

Do they hold views incompatible with American principles?
Are they unlikely to assimilate into American culture?
Would their presence be detrimental to our culture and cultural cohesion?

MACE WIN: $1.9 MILLION for drone capabilities at Joint Base Charleston and tri-county emergency management.

We helped Charleston County and Joint Base Charleston secure $1.9 million through the South Carolina Department of Veterans Affairs Military Enhancement Fund Grant to expand unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) capabilities across Berkeley, Charleston, and Dorchester Counties.

This is a HUGE win. UAS and counter-UAS capabilities are a priority for our national defense and domestic security.

Communities deserve to be safe, and it starts with strong coordination at every level of law enforcement.

We introduced the Incentivizing Cooperation in Immigration Enforcement Act, legislation to reward states and localities partnering with federal immigration authorities and put them first in line for federal public safety funding.

Local leaders who step up deserve support, not the same treatment as jurisdictions obstructing federal law enforcement. This legislation backs those who cooperate

President Trump protects and upholds the Christian faith, not just here in America but around the world. 

We are one nation under God. 

May God bless President Trump and may God bless the United States of America.
